result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears largely functional and well-designed. A few minor layout issues exist with truncated content at the edges.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third item 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off on the right edge with truncated text and a partially visible card.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for horizontal scroll carousels, but ensure enough visual affordance (peek) is shown so users know to scroll. Consider adding a fade or gradient edge to indicate more content.

issues.description: The category filter row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') appears cut off on the right, suggesting more categories exist off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add a scroll indicator or partial peek of the next category to make horizontal scrollability more discoverable.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the ramen card is white/outlined while the one on the pizza card below has a dark circular background, creating visual inconsistency between cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
